openClinicalQuestions: Confirm which pelvic-pain presentations WHD physiotherapy will not see before a medical review.

claimLedger.claim: Sudden severe pelvic pain needs emergency help. Recurring pain needs a GP.
claimLedger.limitations: UK triage page; local emergency numbers differ.

claimLedger.claim: Endometriosis can cause painful periods and pain with sex or opening the bowels.
